in_marathi.name: Dhaneswar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhaneswar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dhaneswar is derived from two Sanskrit words: Dhan (wealth) and Ishwar (God). This name is often used to honor the Hindu deity Ganesha, who is considered the lord of wealth and prosperity.
